newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps to launch Brazilian venture.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps to launch Brazilian venture.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesady its credit rating subsidiary will launch a joint venture in Brazil.

Duff & Phelps said it will work with S.R. Rating of Rio de Janeiro to form S.R. Rating/Duff & Phelps Credit Rating, Prestacao de Servicios Ltda. The new agency will rate both foreign and local currency issues originating from Brazilian firms, said Duff & Phelps.
Duff & Phelps Credit Rating began building its network in Latin America in the early 1990s, forming affiliations in Chile, Mexico, Peru, Venezuela, Argentina and Colombia.
